Summaries.Author: CoolProp team (Ian Bell et al.) / SMath Studio Wrapper
Summaries.Description: A native SMath Studio wrapper of the CoolProp library (www.coolprop.org) providing high-accuracy thermodynamic and transport properties for pure fluids, pseudo-pure fluids, mixtures and humid air. All inputs and outputs are unit-aware SI values.
Summaries.Title: CoolProp Wrapper
